label: Source support for purity as perfection of being from q.4 a.2 ad 3 on life and wisdom
note: Ad 3 treats life and wisdom as perfections of being: subsistent being includes them because none of the perfections of being can be lacking to it, and what participates being need not participate it according to every mode of being. That bears on the premise for life and wisdom only. The premise says it of every pure perfection, and purity is the analyst's classification. The passage gives no criterion for which perfections are perfections of being beyond the second proof's 'secundum hoc enim aliqua perfecta sunt, quod aliquo modo esse habent'.
